column3: “the oak(s)” renders a word that may mean “terebinth” or “great tree.”
“El-bethel” means “God of Bethel,” and “God had revealed Himself” has a plural verb in the Hebrew.
“God Almighty” renders “El Shaddai,” and “a company of nations” renders “an assembly (qahal) of nations.”
“some distance” renders an uncertain measure of distance.
“Ben-oni” means “son of my sorrow (strength),” and “Benjamin” means “son of the right hand.”
“the tower of Eder” means “tower of the flock.”
the Hebrew has a gap marked within the verse, and the Greek adds “and it was evil in his sight.”
